sources.title: Post-game live reaction: Seahawks vs Cowboys Preseason Game 1
sources.description: The Seattle Seahawks marched down the field with Drew Lock at the helm, aided by two big penalties on the Dallas Cowboys, before punching it in for a 7-0 to kick off the game. After taking more than seven minutes off the clock, wide receiver Montorie Foster Jr. scored the first touchdown of the preseason […]
